long_biography.plain_text:
Greek spirits businessman Spyros Metaxas chaired Athens' bid to host the 1996 Olympic Games, aiming to bring the centenary competition back to its modern birthplace. He personally paid architect and urban planner Georges Candilis to prepare the Greek candidature. The campaign ended in defeat when the Games were awarded to Atlanta.

Metaxas also supported ELPIDA, the Greek association helping children with cancer, through financial donations. Accompanied by his daughter Laura, he attended the opening of its children's oncology unit in 2010. The new complex became part of Aghia Sophia Children's Hospital, bringing specialist treatment facilities into the public hospital system.

uncertainties.detail: Metaxa and Metaxas are transliteration variants; the immutable display name remains unchanged. The nineteenth-century founder, engineer at Netcompany-Intrasoft, Save the Motion photographer, musician and Greek-Swiss lawyer are excluded. Independent vessel evidence resolves the family businessman. Launch and input ownership dates are not forced into agreement.

Family ownership before succession, father-and-sons stewardship, family sale and personal retained equity support the medium-confidence transfer inference. The acquired brand belonged to that same platform. No deed, probate or exact allocation between brothers was found; no narrower inheritance subtype is asserted. Enterprise expansion does not alone prove a separate self-made fortune.

Current classifications refer to the subject at death in 2025, not his heirs or the present owners of the brands. Toorank was also sold out of the Metaxa group in 1990, so it is not carried as a later owned asset. General business activity and past residential property are insufficient to choose a terminal Investor, Operator or real-estate sector.

Exact birth day and month remain unestablished. Main-residence ranking among Athens, Gstaad and Monaco is not reliably supported; no residence correction is proposed. The Alive baseline is superseded by death evidence. Death components remain review candidates because the strict baseline applicability rule blocks their fill proposals until a new export.

Forbes was checked first. LinkedIn, Instagram and personal websites were prioritised; Facebook, Twitter/X, YouTube, TikTok, Wikipedia, company sites, Vimeo, Flickr, Trip Advisor and Zillow were also checked. No attributable personal profile was verified. LinkedIn engineer and photographer profiles, brand accounts, founder histories and a namesake restaurant are excluded. The sold company's website is not proposed as a current personal business link.

The Athenian PDF direct requests failed, but complete relevant indexed article text was read. The Savona and AHEPA PDFs were read directly. No allegations, private contact data, speculative Olympic causation or uncle's hospital donation is attributed to the subject.
Spirits & distilling is the minimum useful active tag. An Olympic bidding role does not make him an Olympian. Charitable giving remains narrative; no new tag or formal taxonomy candidate is created.
